Chef Jean-Georges introduces his latest venture, a casually elegant restaurant ensconced in the 
picturesque town of Pound Ridge, New York. Here, Jean-Georges cultivates a truly seasonal, 
farm-to-table cuisine, with ingredients sourced from the Hudson Valley and New England, 
whenever possible. Constructed in 1833 as a residence and serving later as an inn, the building has 
been painstakingly renovated to preserve as many of the original materials as possible, including

rustic sensibility; zinc and marble accent stone and reclaimed wood. The restaurant's lighting,

Travel Disruption Alert: Italy General Strike 21 Apr 
A nationwide general strike has been announced to take place on 21st April 2017 in Italy. 
Members travelling to/from the country on 21 April should reconfirm flight schedules due to a 
series of strikes by aviation workers impacting several airports, as well as the national carrier 
Alitalia, EasyJet and Meridiana fly airlines. Ground handling staff at Verona Villafranca (VRN), 
Rome Fiumicino (FCO), Turin (TRN), Venice Marco Polo (VCE) and Padua (QPA) airports will 
hold a strike from 10.00 to 18.00 (local time), and at Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) from 10.00 
to 14.00. Cabin crew and pilots from easyJet and Alitalia will observe a strike between 10.00 and 
18.00. Staff from Meridiana fly will stage a walkout from 12.00 to 16.00. Call the number on the 
back of your card if you need assistance. Thank you for using American Express Travel.
